topic: Tenses – Tests: Simple Present – Complex Test 1
title: Simple Present Test 1

explanation.tr:
Simple Present testi (kolay). Kontrol et:
• he/she/it → fiil + s/es (works, goes, watches, studies)
• Olumsuz: don't / doesn't + yalın fiil
• Soru: Do / Does + özne + yalın fiil?
• be: am / is / are
• Sinyal: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day
explanation.tk:
Simple Present synagy (aňsat). Barla:
• he/she/it → işlik + s/es (works, goes, watches, studies)
• Ýokluk: don't / doesn't + esasy işlik
• Sorag: Do / Does + eýe + esasy işlik?
• be: am / is / are
• Alamat: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day
explanation.ru:
Тест по Simple Present (лёгкий). Проверь:
• he/she/it → глагол + s/es (works, goes, watches, studies)
• Отрицание: don't / doesn't + начальная форма
• Вопрос: Do / Does + подлежащее + начальная форма?
• be: am / is / are
• Маркеры: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day

examples.en: He goes to school by bus.
examples.ru: Он ездит в школу на автобусе.

examples.tr: Her zaman saat 1'de öğle yemeği yeriz.

exercises.question: Find the mistake: "He don't like fish."

topic: Tenses – Tests: Simple Present  – Complex Test 2
title: Simple Present Test 2

explanation.tr:
Simple Present testi (orta seviye):
• Alışkanlıklar, genel gerçekler, tarifeler (The train leaves at 7.)
• Sıklık zarflarının yeri: ana fiilden önce (She often reads), be'den sonra (He is always late).
• Wh-sorular: How often do you…? What time does it start?
• Özne soruları: Who lives here? (does yok)
• Durum fiilleri: know, want, need, believe, belong
explanation.tk:
Simple Present synagy (orta dereje):
• Endikler, umumy hakykatlar, tertipnamalar (The train leaves at 7.)
• Ýygylyk hallarynyň orny: esasy işlikden öň (She often reads), be-den soň (He is always late).
• Wh-soraglar: How often do you…? What time does it start?
• Eýe soraglary: Who lives here? (does ýok)
• Ýagdaý işlikleri: know, want, need, believe, belong
explanation.ru:
Тест по Simple Present (средний уровень):
• Привычки, общие истины, расписания (The train leaves at 7.)
• Место наречий частоты: перед глаголом (She often reads), после be (He is always late).
• Специальные вопросы: How often do you…? What time does it start?
• Вопросы к подлежащему: Who lives here? (без does)
• Глаголы состояния: know, want, need, believe, belong

examples.en: How often do you go swimming?

topic: Tenses – Tests: Simple Past – Present Perfect – Complex Test
title: Test: Simple Past or Present Perfect?

explanation.tr:
Bu testte Simple Past ile Present Perfect arasında seçim yapacaksın:
• Belli geçmiş zaman (yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when?) → Simple Past
• Belirsiz zaman / şimdiye bağlantı (ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far, recently) → Present Perfect
• Deneyim sorusu + ayrıntı: Have you ever...? – Yes, I ... last year.
• Bitmiş dönem (ölen kişi, eski iş) → Simple Past
explanation.tk:
Bu synagda Simple Past bilen Present Perfect arasynda saýlaw edersiň:
• Belli geçmiş wagt (yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when?) → Simple Past
• Näbelli wagt / häzir bilen baglanyşyk (ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far, recently) → Present Perfect
• Tejribe soragy + jikme-jiklik: Have you ever...? – Yes, I ... last year.
• Gutaran döwür (aradan çykan adam, öňki iş) → Simple Past
explanation.ru:
В этом тесте нужно выбирать между Simple Past и Present Perfect:
• Указанное время в прошлом (yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when?) → Simple Past
• Неопределённое время / связь с настоящим (ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far, recently) → Present Perfect
• Вопрос об опыте + подробности: Have you ever...? – Yes, I ... last year.
• Завершённый период (умерший человек, прежняя работа) → Simple Past

examples.ru: Я был в Турции. Ездил туда в 2021 году.

topic: Tenses – Tests: Simple Present – Present Progressive – Complex Test 1
title: Test: Simple Present or Present Progressive? (1)

explanation.tr:
Bu testte iki şimdiki zaman arasında seçim yapacaksın:
• Simple Present: her zaman / genelde / alışkanlık → every day, usually, always, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: şu an → now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
Aynı cümlede ikisi: I usually drink tea, but now I'm drinking juice.
explanation.tk:
Bu synagda iki häzirki zamanyň arasynda saýlaw edersiň:
• Simple Present: hemişe / adatça / endik → every day, usually, always, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: häzir → now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
Bir sözlemde ikisi: I usually drink tea, but now I'm drinking juice.
explanation.ru:
В этом тесте нужно выбирать между двумя настоящими временами:
• Simple Present: всегда / обычно / привычка → every day, usually, always, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: сейчас → now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
Оба в одном предложении: I usually drink tea, but now I'm drinking juice.

topic: Tenses – Tests: Simple Present – Present Progressive – Complex Test 2
title: Test: Simple Present or Present Progressive? (2)

explanation.tr:
İleri seviye Simple Present / Present Progressive testi:
• Kalıcı durum (Simple Present) ↔ geçici durum (Progressive): I live in Mary. / I'm living with friends this month.
• Değişen/gelişen durumlar Progressive: The city is growing fast.
• Can sıkıcı tekrar: always + Progressive: He's always losing his keys!
• Tarife Simple Present, kişisel plan Progressive: The film starts at 8. We're meeting at 7.30.
• Durum fiilleri anlam değiştirince Progressive olabilir: I think it's good (fikir) / I'm thinking about it (düşünüyorum).
explanation.tk:
Ýokary derejeli Simple Present / Present Progressive synagy:
• Hemişelik ýagdaý (Simple Present) ↔ wagtlaýyn ýagdaý (Progressive): I live in Mary. / I'm living with friends this month.
• Üýtgeýän/ösýän ýagdaýlar Progressive: The city is growing fast.
• Gaharlandyrýan gaýtalanma: always + Progressive: He's always losing his keys!
• Tertipnama Simple Present, şahsy meýilnama Progressive: The film starts at 8. We're meeting at 7.30.
• Ýagdaý işlikleri manysy üýtgände Progressive bolup biler: I think it's good (pikir) / I'm thinking about it (oýlanýaryn).
explanation.ru:
Тест повышенного уровня: Simple Present или Present Progressive:
• Постоянное (Simple Present) ↔ временное (Progressive): I live in Mary. / I'm living with friends this month.
• Меняющиеся ситуации — Progressive: The city is growing fast.
• Раздражающая привычка: always + Progressive: He's always losing his keys!
• Расписание — Simple Present, личный план — Progressive: The film starts at 8. We're meeting at 7.30.
• Глаголы состояния в другом значении могут быть в Progressive: I think it's good (мнение) / I'm thinking about it (обдумываю).
